decisions.reason: The source confirms that the Hero V is working and must be carried forward, but it does not change its already-fixed geometry or other current attributes.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the requirement to use complete-wordmark iterations, preserve locked elements, and vary only the element under review.
The source reports that the second V is currently working and should remain preserved, but it does not change the second V's construction rules or geometry.
The complete-wordmark review format does not alter the established second-V height hierarchy; the source only requires approved relationships to remain visible and unchanged.
The source does not introduce a new peak-alignment rule or alter the existing shared-horizon requirement.
The source reiterates the already-established literal copy/paste derivation and requires its preservation, but does not change the candidate's current derivation attributes.
Requiring E and L concepts to appear in complete wordmarks does not establish or change any kerning, spacing, or rhythm value.
The source requires complete wordmarks but does not change the existing all-caps case treatment.
The source concerns architectural integration and review format, not the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
The source explains why isolated E and L concepts cannot be evaluated but does not change the requirement to provide short design rationales for each round.
The complete-wordmark presentation requirement does not affect accepted review-image file formats or delivery methods.
